## If the enemy team has 2  or more of these heroes:  [Reinhardt](hero_a3b6ca2c-6cbd-43dc-bb78-a728e42fba49)  [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54)  [Freja](hero_e80840a1-845d-4008-966c-585b7cb4a424)  [Junkrat](hero_3ac20f6c-2bce-45f3-998e-9129cc6e5c05)  [Mei](hero_36fd67f0-19df-4c50-add9-709cfb147cb0)  [Pharah](hero_0baf7420-ff13-4b92-81f7-ca21b61dacf9)  [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546) 

then buy:  [Ballistic Buffer](item_40146dd3-a8cb-40ca-8917-c430bfa2be0e) instead of  [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) 

## How to play this build:

- 1: don't die. so stay back, **use your shield bash for running away** rather than running in. and you really don't have to swing, this is mostly a Whipshot build.

- 2: ABP. Always Be Poking. Use your Whipshot any and every chance you get.

- 3: Have fun.

## Specific Matchups:
- [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88) = play really far back, never engage in a fight with him.  [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88) is your biggest counter.
- [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85) = don't even bother whipping her, unless there's no one else to whip.
- [D.Va](hero_e8e1dc68-45c4-47c2-b421-95e33594e6b6) = try to time your whips to cancel her slam. play as if shes a ball, just try to boop her slams. if shes not playing the slam build = just spam whipping her.  [D.Va](hero_e8e1dc68-45c4-47c2-b421-95e33594e6b6) is the easiest and best whip target. because she's huge and doesn't have a barrier to cancel your whip.
- [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1) = 2nd best whipping target. doesn't have that much defense for your whip, and with  [Maces to Faces](item_072c4780-53a1-4abd-9fc9-32406c3b7b49) you can easily get her even if her hitbox is small.

## How to play:

Now THIS is your big spike. you have 31m range on your whipshot. **SO PLEASE USE THAT RANGE TO PLAY SAFE.**

The further the target, the more the damage. so focus on  [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546) 's on the highground. or  [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) 's trying to play safely. 1 whip is all it takes for them to pretty much be useless for 4 seconds because of the amount of damage 1 whip's done to them.

But if your tank is getting mogged by the enemy tank, then try to help them out by whipping the tank. (unless its  [Orisa](hero_91644d44-1093-4f62-ac51-020975465e85)  cause that cow doesn't give a bleep :P)

- TLDR: Whip people out of high grounds. if enemy tank is winning vs your tank, then focus their tank with whips. (AND DONT FORGET TO PACK!)
